text: The attached report presents the outcomes achieved on the objectives established in Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s 2022 Annual Plan. It includes results and insights regarding successes and challenges for the four focus areas - deep retrofits, net zero new construction, electrification of transportation and the electricity system - and for the functional teams that enable all aspects of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s work. Progress against Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s performance indicators - carbon emission reduction potential, mobilization of capital for low-carbon solutions, scaling potential, community benefits and equity - is presented quantitatively and qualitatively.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received the report (January 27, 2023) from the Vice President, Strategy and Partnerships, Toronto Atmospheric Fund for information.
